NAME:
   rancher grant - Grant a role to a user or group at project, cluster, or global scope

USAGE:
   rancher grant [flags] <subject>

FLAGS:
   --cluster string   cluster scope, or the cluster the --project is in
   --global           global scope
   --help, -h         show help
   --project id|name  project scope: project id|name
   --role id          role for the scope: a roletemplate id (project/cluster) or globalrole `id` (global); discover with: `rancher get roletemplates` (project/cluster) or `rancher get globalroles` (global)
   --type string      subject type, user or group; the CLI infers it from a principal prefix it recognizes, and requires it for any other principal prefix

GLOBAL FLAGS:
   --allow-deprecated          allow writing to a deprecated resource
   --apply                     apply the change
   --color string              auto|always|never
   --config string, -c string  path to the config directory [$RANCHER_CLI_CONFIG_DIR]
   --debug                     print telemetry upload details on stderr (development builds)
   --dry-run                   preview the changes without applying them
   --no-input                  never prompt; fail with an error when the input is ambiguous
   --output string, -o string  table|wide|json|yaml|name|template=<go-template>
   --read-only                 refuse commands that make changes in this run; once set it cannot be turned off; local commands do not accept it
   --yes                       confirm a destructive change
